summary: Revise at 6.2, up from 5.6 in round 1. Caiman scores 7 and the ship bar is 7.5. Every gate is green and verified in report.json and verification.json, and the template gate is now recorded and passes (1 design.set patch, 793,951 of 1,000,000 bytes). Two fixes worked. The broken wreath frame is gone. The cheek sprays are now the best passage on the ring: side.png shows a touching triangle of three garnets between spiny leaves, with no cones. The garland is now 7 leaves a side with no bare gaps. The face is still the weak point, and the face sells the ring. (1) The face leaves were not enlarged: still 6.3 mm (punch asked for 7.5 x 5.5) at 0.7 mm (asked for 0.8). The gable folds each leaf on the parting line, so face.png and stones.png show a flat pale upper half and a lower half that reads as a cut-out notch with vertical walls and stair-stepped spines. Each leaf reads as a bat or a crown, not a glossy curved blade. (2) The new table matte is two hard-edged rectangular stipple panels above and below the sprig. The two panels render as different textures (pitted above, wavy below). They read as sandpaper patches set into a box and divide the table into three bands; they do not set the sprig in a field. (3) Stair-steps remain on the face-leaf margins, the garland scallops and the cheek-leaf tips. The third cheek leaf on each end ('Cheek leaf 1/2, 3' at 62.9 deg) is clipped at the head corner in side.png and shoulder.png. (4) The garland reads as a crenellated scalloped fringe of flat vertical-walled plates (reverse.png, palm.png), not overlapping leaves on a stem. The 'Garland stem' is a height-field curve hidden under the plates, not the cad::twist sweep that was asked for. (5) The new 'Bark' tiling on the shank flanks renders as vertical combing and streaks (reverse.png, shoulder.png, side.png). That is exactly the smearing the checklist forbids. Holly still reads at 300 px with no caption, but as a polished box carrying a holly badge, well short of Caiman's fully worked surfaces or the Reptilia sheet. One round remains, and the punch list below can lift this ring only if the face is rebuilt.
strengths: Holly reads at 300 px with no caption: spined leaves around a tight red triangle of berries, on the face and on both cheeks (hero-300, face-300, contact-300).
The cheek sprays are much improved. Each cheek has a touching three-garnet triangle, flush and low, between spined leaves with cut veins. The metal cones from round 1 are gone (side.png).
The wreath chips are deleted, and the face carries one sprig with no scattered frame.
The garland now runs continuously down both shoulders, 7 leaves a side graded by the 0.24 taper. All 16 parting-line stamps pass parting_monotone at draft, coarse and export.
The face leaves now carry separate vein strokes (veins 1a to 4b) instead of a comb, and they read as veins in hero.png.
Every gate is green, and the template gate passes with a base preset node, 1 patch and mesh parity.
The factory 006 table keeps its hard wall-to-face angles (bare-vs-finished.png), and the palm stays bare as planned.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: Holly only, in a connected scheme: the face sprig, a matching spray on each end wall, a continuous garland down each shoulder and a bare palm. The wreath chips are gone. It passes narrowly, because the rectangular matte panels and the combed bark are textures that say no holly.

checklist.item: Reads as its plant at 300 px without the caption
checklist.reason: hero-300 and face-300 read as holly: spined leaves and red berry bunches. The garland fringe reads as decoration, not as holly, at that size.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true outlines, crisp, no combing/smearing/stair-steps
checklist.reason: stones.png still shows stair-stepped walls on the lower half of each face leaf and on its spine tips. The garland scallops are stepped in reverse.png. The cheek leaves break into chips at their tips in shoulder.png. The new Bark tiling renders as vertical combing and streaks on both shank flanks.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings, visible, coloured as fruit
checklist.reason: 9 garnets in gypsy-mound seats, berry red, set as two-berry-on-one triangles on the face and both cheeks. The cones are gone. One small fault: in face.png the cheek bunches poke past the table's ends as red blobs, which is acceptable.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms sculpted
checklist.reason: Every leaf is still a constant-height plate with vertical walls. The face-leaf gable reads as a fold with a cliff, not a cupped blade. The matte is two hard rectangles, and the garland is a row of identical flat scallop plates. Nothing curls, overlaps or swells.

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps its hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: The table edges and end walls stay crisp, matching the bare stock in bare-vs-finished.png.

checklist.item: Silhouette distinct from other Vepres rings
checklist.reason: This is the only square 006 signet in Vepres. The garland fringe now breaks the shoulder silhouette a little.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Large: the bare box. Medium: the sprig and the sprays. Small: veins, matte and bark. The medium forms still cover only about a third of the table, and the end walls and flanks are mostly smooth metal or smeared texture. That is far below Caiman's fully articulated table and walls, or Varanus on the Reptilia sheet.

punch_list.zone: Face leaves 'Face leaf, 1' / 'Face leaf, 2' (theta 73.8 / 106.2 deg, v 9.86 on crest_at)
punch_list.change: This is round 1 punch 2, still not done. Grow each leaf from 6.3 to 7.5 mm long and from about 4 to 5.5 mm wide, so the pair spans about 15 of the 16 mm table with tips 0.7 mm from the head ends; keep the berry triangle between them by moving the leaf centres out to about +/-4.3 mm. Replace the single-crease gable, which leaves the lower half as a cliff, with a domed or two-slope top: rise 0.45 mm on the midrib, falling to 0.15 mm at the margin on both sides, so the lower half also catches light. Height 0.8 mm. Deepen the midrib bench cut from 0.1 to 0.2 mm with a round section. Keep parting_monotone true; if it fails, use hull_and_bays for the spine bays.
punch_list.acceptance: report.json placed.face_leaf_mm about [7.5, 7.5] and parting_monotone true for both. face.png: the upper and lower halves of each leaf read as one lit blade with a midrib ridge; no notch-shaped dark cut-out below the parting line. hero-300: the leaves fill most of the table's length.

punch_list.zone: All struck leaf outlines: face, cheek and garland stamps
punch_list.change: This is round 1 punch 3, still not done. Kill the stair-steps: resample every leaf outline to 512 or more points with arc spines, and raise the chart or strike resolution under the stamps (or strike them as true geometry) so the walls are continuous. Add a 0.1 mm top-edge round on every leaf. Pull 'Cheek leaf 1/2, 3' (theta 62.9 deg, v 18.59 / 1.13) 1.0 mm in from the head corner so it is whole, not clipped.
punch_list.acceptance: stones.png, side.png and shoulder.png at full size: no zig-zag or stepped wall on any leaf margin or spine; spine tips are clean points; every cheek leaf is a whole outline with no part lost over the corner.

punch_list.zone: Layer 'Table matte' (Tiling 'Ilex matte', theta 66.5-113.5, v 12.36-15.61, mirror_v)
punch_list.change: Replace the two hard rectangular panels with one even field: a fine stipple of 0.03-0.04 mm height over the whole table, inset 0.8 mm from the table edge, with a 0.4 mm polished halo round each leaf and berry (mask the stamps out) instead of open polished bands. Upper and lower halves must render the same texture: drop mirror_v or fix its phase.
punch_list.acceptance: face.png: one uniform matte field from edge inset to edge inset with the polished sprig standing out; no rectangular panel edges; top and bottom textures identical.

punch_list.zone: Layers 'Bark, left' / 'Bark, right' (Tiling 'Ilex bark', theta -8 +/- 46 and the mirror, v 1.2-6.8)
punch_list.change: The bark renders as combing and streaks. Either delete it, or replace it with a smooth, low (0.04 mm), long-wavelength holly-bark alpha with no fine vertical striations, sampled finer than the export chart (1536 around), fading out 3 mm before the palm.
punch_list.acceptance: reverse.png, shoulder.png and side.png: no vertical streaks or comb marks on the shank flanks; the surface reads as either clean polish or soft, even bark.

punch_list.zone: Shoulder garland 'Garland leaf, left/right 1-7' and 'Garland stem, left/right' (theta 36.4 to -57.2 and 143.6 to 239.2)
punch_list.change: Make it read as leaves on a vine, not a scalloped fringe. Alternate each station's rot_deg by +/-25 deg so the leaves splay off the stem in turn. Give each leaf a Gable or domed top, rise 0.2 mm. Raise the stem curve to 0.6 mm wide and 0.3 mm proud so it shows between the leaves. Add one 1.0 mm cast berry dot on the line at stations 2, 4 and 6 if DFM allows.
punch_list.acceptance: reverse.png and palm.png: individual spined leaves set alternately off a visible stem down each shoulder; no reading as a crenellated strip; parting_monotone true on all 14; DFM 0.

punch_list.zone: Head end walls between the cheek spray and the table edge
punch_list.change: Fill the bare polish on each end wall: grow the cheek leaves from 5.0 x 2.6 to 6.0 x 3.2 mm so the spray covers about 60% of the wall, keeping concave bays at least 1 mm below the rim.
punch_list.acceptance: side.png: the spray fills most of the end wall, and the three leaves frame the berry triangle with no large plain areas.
